## Extraction ledger — COMPLETE

Every FAIL, PARTIAL and smaller observation in this run now has a card. This record stays open as the aggregation node; it carries `tracking`, so the triage seat correctly skips it and it is **not** itself a dispatch candidate.

| Run item | Finding | Card | Lane |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `builtin-apps-nav-render` (a) | Signing Keys (JWKS) is a dead nav entry — a permission gate cannot prune an API-disabled object | #7544 | `domain:metadata` |
| `builtin-apps-nav-render` (b) | App baseline **replaces** rather than composes with platform `member_default` — 10 nav ids served, 7/7 objects 403 | #7555 | `domain:identity` |
| `metadata-registry-serving` · `metadata-authoring-roundtrip` | `/meta/types` + `/meta/:type/:name/published` swallowed by the `/meta/:type` catch-all | #7526 | `domain:cli` |
| `metadata-authoring-roundtrip` | Object-extension overlay missing from the by-name meta route — overlay fields unsettable through the UI | #7556 | `domain:metadata` |
| `metadata-authoring-roundtrip` | Studio page-create never completes (`recordChrome` strictly rejected) | objectstack-ai/objectui#4232 | objectui |
| `settings-hub-roundtrip` | **SECURITY** — encrypted settings echoed as plaintext on read | #7522 → PR #7554 | `domain:services` |
| `package-lifecycle` (A)+(B) | Disable is not an enforcement for objects; uninstall leaves 7 orphaned `sys_metadata` rows | #7557 | `domain:engine-core` |
| `package-lifecycle` (C) | Commit-revert `VERSION_NOT_FOUND` while `/history` shows that very row; package revert 500s | #7559 | `domain:metadata` |
| `package-lifecycle` (D) | ADR-0070 read-only gate missing — platform packages can be disabled **and deleted** | #7560 | `domain:cli` |
| `app-management-toggle` | Post-login landing ignores `isDefault`; Disable / Set-as-default are client-only stubs | objectstack-ai/objectui#4233 | objectui |
| `shell-nav-personalization` | Sidebar collapse cookie is written but never read back | objectstack-ai/objectui#4234 | objectui |
| `nav-surfaces-render` (PARTIAL) | The red assertion is the **test's own** timing race, disproven as a product defect — poll `boundingBox` instead of a fixed 1500 ms wait | #7569 | `domain:devx` |
| Smaller obs | `/meta/diagnostics` reports 94/94 registry entries INVALID, including on the platform's own `__search` column | #7561 | `domain:engine-core` |
| Smaller obs | Console **home** header renders a second inbox polling `sys_inbox_message` | objectstack-ai/objectui#4235 | objectui |
| Smaller obs | `GET /meta/app?id=…` filter is inert | #7566 | `domain:cli` |

The 3 PASS items produced no cards, as expected.

### Two things a reader of this run needs to know

**1. `#7526` is a cross-run card.** The two shadowed `/meta` routes here are the same defect class as `/meta/objects/:name/state/:field` from the api-backend run #7463 — three instances, one root cause. The card's deliverable is therefore not the three routes but the **missing route-ledger ↔ live-mount parity gate**: the existing route audit (#3642 / PR #3658) treats the ledger as ground truth for what is mounted, which is precisely the assumption these defects falsify, so that audit is green on this class by construction.

**2. A measurement conflict the `#7555` implementer must resolve rather than inherit.** This run measures the platform `member_default` as granting **23** objects; open issue #7344 (framework `88154bee1`) states it grants only the better-auth identity tables plus `sys_user_preference`. Both cannot be right. #7555 instructs the dev to measure rather than trust either number.

### Stale-premise status

The whole batch was checked against **all 191 PRs merged into `objectstack` since 2026-08-10**; none of these defects appears already fixed. That check was not optional theatre — a sibling card from this batch (#7524, approvals run) was closed precisely because PR #7395 had fixed it hours after build `a86db175` was cut.

One residual risk is recorded on #7556: PR #7306 (ADR-0029 D9, tenant overlay becomes its own contributor layer) merged 2026-08-10T09:34Z, right around the cut. It targets tenant `_provenance:'org'` overlays rather than a code-declared extension, so it is not a fix — but re-measure on current `main` before implementing.
